parsed.public_message: Green honors its announced notice: earliest initiation t525. These orders remain neutral and consolidate our army east of the centre, approximately x675–710, z625–655.

private_messages.Claude: White now visibly has Alexander, 9 Foot Companions, 19 Cretan archers, 4 lancers and 4 skirmish cavalry around (606,705). I propose mutual nonaggression while White lives, terminable with 25 seconds' notice. If you accept, we can coordinate pressure on White from south and east beginning at the next pause.
private_messages.Gemini: Green is consolidating east of x675 and remains neutral for this interval. Our notice permits initiation from t525; we are not advancing toward your western position.
private_messages.Grok: Green remains neutral for this interval, honoring our t525 earliest-initiation notice. We are consolidating east of the centre without advancing toward your northern position.

parsed.explanation: We honor the final interval of our notice while placing the archers behind a western screen and keeping the army inside the eventual ring. The elephants cover the northwest approach and spearmen cover the southwest. A proposed agreement with Orange could let us pressure White from two directions.
